_comment: Sightwell fork: product-name branding applied by the Go bundle (i18n/brand.go) and the React loader (frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts). Only keys where 'NetBird' names this app are listed; technology names stay.
_linksComment: About page links. GitHub, Forum and Feedback (NetBird's) are not shown; the client is BSD-3-Clause, so links are ours to choose. releases: Changelog and What's new (our fork's GitHub releases, same source as the update check in version/update.go).
_selfHostedComment: Applied only when features.netbirdCloud is false: these keys offer NetBird Cloud upstream. Translations are new (reusing each locale's existing terms) and should get a native-speaker review.
